Home | Oxwagon Lodge
Welcome to Oxwagon Lodge, Hartbeespoort Dam
Oxwagon Lodge is a spesialiteitslodge (“specialty lodge”) and one of   the most unusual party venues   in South Africa. With spesialiteitslodge we mean that you sleep in an   original Oxwagon .  Each Oxwagon is   fully restored, cute and cosy!
This is the ideal place for   weddings, celebrations, conferences, reunions, Year End Functions, and for romantic weekend get-aways.
Amenities include a   lapa, restaurant, braai area, dance floor, outdoor amphitheater and Conference Centre . Our party room near the pool has fantastic views of the Hartbeespoort Dam. Visit the   Oxwagon Museum   to understand the advanced technology of 100 years ago. Oxwagon Lodge also has a “cheap and cheerful” backpacker’s accommodation in a converted double-decker bus, with bunk beds. Bring your sense of humour!
Hartbeespoort Dam is the   “ Playground of Gauteng ” .
The   Oxwagon Restaurant   serves Sunday lunch including   oxtailpotjiekos, real farm bread and other traditional dishes.  Or, book a Romantic Sunset Picnic basket.
All   group functions and conference bookings   are welcome. Call Mark and the Team, on   +27 78 075 0720   or email to info@oxwagon.co.za
